theorem lg_target {α : Type u_1} {ι : Type u_2} (t : Finset ι) (s : ι → Set α) : (⋃ i ∈ t, s i).ncard ≤ ∑ i ∈ t, (s i).ncard := by
  let u := ⋃ i ∈ t, s i
  have h1 : u.finite := Finset.bUnion_finite t (λ i => (s i).finite)
  have h2 : (u.ncard : ℕ) ≤ (∑ i ∈ t, (s i).ncard : ℕ) := Finset.sum_bUnion_le t s
  exact h2
